failureAnalysis.reasoning: The test failed because the application did not redirect the user to the dashboard after entering valid credentials. Instead, the page remained on the login page with an 'Invalid session token' error. The TimeoutException in the automation script was a secondary effect of waiting for a redirection that never occurred due to this application-side token issue.

defectReport.title: Login Failure: Valid credentials fail to authenticate with 'Invalid session token' error
defectReport.description: During the execution of the automated login test with valid credentials, the application failed to redirect the user to the dashboard. The page remained on the login screen, and an 'Invalid session token' error was encountered, causing the test to time out while waiting for the dashboard redirection.
stepsToReproduce: Observe the page URL and any error messages.
defectReport.expectedResult: User is successfully authenticated and redirected to the '/dashboard' page.
defectReport.actualResult: User remains on the '/login' page, and an 'Invalid session token' error occurs, preventing redirection.
defectReport.possibleRootCause: The authentication service or backend API is generating or validating session tokens incorrectly, resulting in an 'Invalid session token' error even when valid credentials are provided.
defectReport.supportingEvidence: Error: Invalid session token. Exception: TimeoutException at LoginPage.java:42, LoginTest.java:18.
defectReport.recommendation: Investigate the token generation and validation logic on the authentication server. Ensure that the backend correctly issues a valid session token upon successful verification of valid credentials.
